NDT software in Linden, NJ: working the Chemical Coast

Linden sits in the middle of New Jersey's Chemical Coast, the industrial strip along the Arthur Kill between Elizabeth and Perth Amboy, and its inspection market is shaped by a handful of very large sites. Phillips 66's Bayway refinery, straddling the Linden and Elizabeth line, is the northernmost refinery on the East Coast, with crude, FCC, reforming, alkylation and hydrotreating units plus a polypropylene plant. Linden Cogeneration, one of the largest cogeneration plants in the country, supplies steam and power to the refinery and the regional grid. The Colonial Pipeline system terminates in the Linden area, and the tank terminals along the Arthur Kill, in Linden, Carteret, Sewaren and Bayonne, hold a large share of the fuel that moves into New York Harbor. Port Newark-Elizabeth, a few miles north, adds cranes, container handling equipment and marine structures.

That mix produces a particular kind of NDT work: refinery turnarounds with short, intense windows; aboveground storage tank inspections with MFL floor scanning, UT thickness on shells and holiday testing on coatings; HRSG and boiler tube inspection at the cogeneration plant; and pipeline and terminal work under PHMSA oversight. New Jersey is an NRC Agreement State, so radiography licensing runs through the NJDEP radiation protection program, and boilers and pressure vessels fall under the NJ Department of Labor's inspection program. The typical Linden-area NDT contractor keeps a core crew of a few dozen people and scales up hard for turnarounds with travelling technicians from across the country.

ERP for NDT companies in Linden, NJ

The Atlantis ERP solution is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies. It brings certifications, procedures, equipment calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quoting, timesheets and invoicing into one system, which matters most when your headcount doubles for a three-week turnaround and then drops back.

Atlantis NDT, founded by ASNT NDT Level III Anoop Rayavarapu, configures the ERP around your methods, your clients' formats and your billing, and supports it after go-live. It is browser-based with an offline field app. The positioning is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with a demo and quote on request. See all modules on the ERP apps page.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Linden turnarounds

Team Assignments runs each job as a dispatch record through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed. Technicians and equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and the system warns you if any equipment on the assignment is out of calibration.

Turnaround surges are where Linden contractors win or lose money. When Bayway or a terminal operator releases a scope, you may need to add a dozen travelling technicians in a week, split crews between the refinery and a tank job in Carteret, and still cover the regular callout work. The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days with overlaps blocked, so a technician already committed to a tank inspection cannot quietly also be put on the turnaround schedule. Each technician shows current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date, in calendar, kanban and list views.

Assignments carry mobilisation and demobilisation dates, useful when travelling crews are on hotel nights and per diems, and site GPS coordinates, useful on large sites and tank farms where the right gate and the right tank are not obvious to someone new. See the Team Assignments app.

Technician certification tracking software for surge crews

The Certificates app records each technician's certifications by scheme, level, method, certifying body, industry sector and dates, and computes status automatically as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires.

When travelling technicians join for a turnaround, the first question from the refinery's contractor-management team is whether every person's certifications, vision test and site qualifications are in date. The ERP holds SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes, each with OJT hours, training hours, examination results and the attached certificate. Vision tests are tracked with Jaeger near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required and the minimum OJT and training hours, so your Level III can check a new hire's file against your written practice quickly.

The employee NDT profile stores radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which your RSO needs for radiographers working under a New Jersey licence. Company certifications, such as your ISO registration and other accreditations, are tracked with alert days too. Configurable daily email alerts cover technician certs, calibration certificates and company certifications. See the Certificates app.

NDT reporting software for tanks, towers and tubes

The NDT Reports app covers 17 report types with method-specific fields and its own numbering per type: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday testing and computed radiography. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector signature where needed.

Linden work leans heavily on a few of those. MFL reports record scan mode and item lines, which suits tank floor scanning at the Arthur Kill terminals. UT thickness reports hold readings by direction for shell courses and nozzles. Holiday testing reports cover the coating checks that follow tank repairs. IRIS and ECT cover heat-exchanger tube bundles pulled during a turnaround, and PWHT and hardness reports cover weld repairs on refinery piping. Every report captures the work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references, and ends with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

The offline field app works inside tank shells and in the parts of a refinery where phones are restricted or signal is poor, storing drafts and photos locally and syncing later, with on-screen signature and PDF preview. Client report formats are handled by versioned templates, with Excel templates filled by mapping fields to cells. See the NDT Reports app and Digital Twin Reporting Software. Asset owners who want thickness and remaining-life trends visualised on a 3D model can use Atlantis Digital Twins alongside the reports.

Calibration management software for Linden NDT equipment

Asset Management tracks every instrument, probe, scanner and accessory by serial number, with lifecycle status, condition, firmware, accessories, calibration frequency and next due date. Calibration records capture provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag and result.

A tank floor MFL scanner, an IRIS system and a PAUT kit are all expensive and all in demand during turnaround season. Reservations with clash prevention stop two jobs being promised the same unit, and the issue and return workflow, with supervisor and manager approval, records condition when a scanner leaves the yard and when it comes back from a tank floor. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements. The calibration certificate register stores the lab's accreditation number, status and PDF, with expiry alerts, and dispatch warns you before an out-of-calibration unit goes to site. Consumables such as couplant, holiday-test supplies, PPE and cleaners carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. See the Asset Management app.

Procedures and Level III approvals

The Procedures app holds your written procedures with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the text or uploaded file. Each revision moves from draft to submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with locked approved revisions, rejection reasons and a snapshot of every revision.

Refinery and terminal clients in the Linden area usually review your procedures before a turnaround, and sometimes ask for client-specific versions. Email reminders keep approvals moving when your Level III is on site, and an AI-assisted first draft helps with new procedures such as an MFL tank floor procedure, always reviewed and approved by a Level III. See the Procedures app.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Linden contractors

Quotations include job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products by method and category, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts to a sales order. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Turnaround billing is where paper falls apart: dozens of technicians, day and night shifts, standby while permits are issued, equipment on day-by-day hire. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag, overtime multiplier and approval, and approved hours feed invoice lines that show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, billing basis and days or hours. Expenses for per diems, hotels, Turnpike tolls and parking are recorded and re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across twelve months. See Quotations, Invoicing and Expenses.

Fleet and radiography source transport

The Fleet app records each vehicle's purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and assignments to projects and drivers with dates and mileage. For radiography crews moving between the refinery, terminals and fabrication shops across Union and Middlesex counties, it keeps vehicle paperwork next to the job it served. See the Fleet app.

Dashboards for Linden operations managers

Dashboards give spreadsheet-style KPI views, including equipment calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return, alongside the financial dashboard. During a turnaround, that is the view an operations manager checks each morning. See the Dashboards app.

Inspection management software in Linden: implementation

Implementation is remote and timed to avoid your busiest turnaround weeks. It starts with discovery of your methods, clients and formats, then imports technicians, certificates, vision tests, equipment and calibration certificates from your spreadsheets, rebuilds your report and quotation templates, and connects other systems through the open REST API, which integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Office staff are trained first, then field technicians on the offline app. Client-specific steps that are not built in are configured during implementation. Ask for an implementation plan for your Linden team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Linden, NJ inspection company?

For contractors serving refineries, terminals and power plants, the best fit handles surge staffing, certifications, equipment, reports and billing together. The Atlantis ERP covers all of those and is configured around your clients.

Does it support tank inspection reports?

Yes. MFL (with scan mode and item lines), UT thickness readings by direction, VT and holiday testing are all built-in report types.

Can we onboard travelling technicians quickly for a turnaround?

Yes. Certificates, vision tests and radiation details can be entered or imported for each person, and status is computed automatically, so gaps show up before the gate check.

Can the offline app be used inside tank shells and process units?

Yes. It stores drafts and photos on the device without signal and syncs later, with photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview.

Will it connect to our accounting or client systems?

Yes, through the open REST API with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How is it priced?

Quote on request. Ask for a quote.
